title: Tracking Scenario Reader
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Tracking Scenario and Sensor Models/Tracking_Scenario_Reader.md
text: Read tracking scenario and generate simulation data, 1 input, 8 outputs, {Random number generation} sets Method to generate random number seed; {Source of scenario} sets the source of tracking scenario, {Workspace variable name}, {Session file}, {Source of platform pose}, {Sample time (s)} sets the sample time of simulation, {Coordinate system to report platform poses}, {Include profiles information with platforms}, {Detections} enables detections output port, {Point clouds} enables port clouds output port, {Emissions} enables emission output port, {Enable occlusion in emission propagation}, {Coverage} enables coverage configurations output port, {Sensor} enables sensor configurations output port, {Emitter} enables emitter configurations output port, {Initial seed}, {Source of platform bus name} sets the source of name for platform poses bus, {Specify platform bus name} sets the platform bus, {Source of maximum number of platforms}, {Maximum number of platforms}, {Source of detection bus name} sets the source of name for detection bus, {Specify detection bus name} sets the detection bus, {Source of maximum number of detections} sets the source of maximum number of platforms, {Maximum number of detections}, {Source of point cloud bus name} sets the source of name for point cloud bus, {Specify point cloud bus name} sets the point cloud bus, {Maximum number of lidar sensors}, {Source of maximum number of lidar sensors}, {Source of emission bus name} sets the source of name for emission bus, {Specify emission bus name} sets the emission bus, {Source of maximum number of emissions}, {Maximum number of emissions}, {Source of coverage configuration bus name} sets the source of name for coverage configuration, {Specify coverage configuration bus name} sets the coverage configuration bus, {Source of sensor configuration bus name} sets the source of name for sensor configuration, {Specify sensor configuration bus name}, {Source of emitter configuration bus name} sets the source of name for emitter configuration, {Specify emitter configuration bus name}, {Source of maximum number of sensors}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Source of maximum number of emitters} and {Maximum number of emitters}. Values come from the instance.
